sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER Heard and perused the record.
This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to Crime No.184/2024 dated (not mentioned),
registered at Police Station- Dewas Industrial Area, District-Dewas (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 506-II, 376(3), 376(2)(N), 212, 366 of IPC and under Section 3/4 2 MCRC-23213-2024 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 03.03.2024.

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he has committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix.
03. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the present applicant is an innocent person and has falsely been implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that on 29.02.2024, statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded before the Trial Court and she has supported the case of prosecution.
The applicant is in custody since 03.03.2024.
Therefore, the application filed by the applicant may be allowed and he may be enlarged on bail.
0 4 . Learned counsel for the respondent / State has opposed the application.

05. Considering the nature of accusation and totality of the facts and circumstances of the case and so also looking to the statement of the prosecutrix, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it proper to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

06. It is directed that the applicant be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the concerned Court on the date fixed in this regard.

The applicant shall also abide by the conditions as enumerated under Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
07.
The present order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump or any breach of aforesaid conditions of this order, the same shall become ineffective.
